column5: Preset and custom turbo-batch policy parsing now mirrors Go JSON field types, zero defaults, ignored unknown fields, source numeric acceptance, and unknown-version fallback behavior. The broader client configuration surface, dynamic reload, security, and transport construction remain external.

The scheduler preserves shared request progress and terminal state, cancellation-aware completion handles, grouping, concurrency admission, Go-style chunked Take limits, and adaptive policy selection. BatchCommands streams, connection lifecycle, packet write and read loops, and async RegionRequest callbacks remain external.

The source-shaped heap preserves priority ordering, raw-layout full Take, pop-ordered partial Take, bounded Take behavior, and backing-array reference clearing without inventing stable equal-priority order. Blocking channel integration and live batch stream ownership remain external.
